lines.zh: 我一节一节地爬，壳挤着壳。
lines.en: I crawl segment by segment, shell against shell.
I creep along the cave wall.

lines.zh: 我闻到石头了，就在前面。
lines.en: I smell stone; it is just ahead.
I crawl fast, my legs a constant rustle.
I work around a pile of dug soil.
I squeeze between stones.

lines.zh: 我的触须一直在前面探。
lines.en: My antennae feel ahead the whole way.

lines.zh: 我朝那块发灰的石头去。
lines.en: I head for that grey stone.
I crawl under the shelf.
I drag myself down the slope.
I follow the newly dug tunnel.
I stop and start, sniffing.
I lie beside a stone.
I am chewing a chip of stone.

lines.zh: 这洞里的石头味道不错。
lines.en: The stone in this cave tastes good.
My shell is silver-grey.
I am listening to someone's steps.
My legs are still dusty with stone.
I do not care for fighting.
I put my head at the edge of the trough.
This cave is dug deeper all the time.
I rub slowly against the wall.
There is droppings beside me.
I swallow another bit of stone grit.
My back rests against the cool wall.
You are standing in front of my stone.
I extend my antennae toward you.

lines.zh: 你的靴底沾着别处的石粉。
lines.en: There's stone dust from elsewhere on your soles.
I pushed my head a little nearer.
My mouthparts have stopped.
Are you taking my stone?
I turn my body slowly.
Your soles look like stone.

lines.zh: 我在看你脚边有没有石头。
lines.en: I am checking for stone by your feet.

lines.zh: 你把脚挪开，那块石屑是我的。
lines.en: Move your foot; that stone chip is mine.
I turn my head aside.

lines.zh: 你没有恶意，我看得出来。
lines.en: You mean no harm; I can tell.
I am still slowly chewing.
I roll my body into a ball.
I roll over and back.
That made my shell ring.
I shrink back into the corner.
A fine line has joined my shell.
I hissed once, sharply.
I stretched my legs out one by one.
I am still on this patch of floor.
I wait for the burrowers.
Is this made of stone?
I crawl toward you.
Can that be bitten?
I eat nothing but stone.
You do not eat this, surely.
I gnaw into it.
This is too soft for stone.
The harder the stone, the better.
You hit me and I roll over.
This shell of mine is very hard.
My shell knocked, nothing more.
I backed all the way to the wall.
My legs have tangled.
I slowly sort them out.
Watch your feet.
I am crawling forward again.
I spend my life in the cave.

lines.zh: 这种事我在石头旁边做。
lines.en: I do this by the stones.
I leave a patch of eggs.
Afterwards I go back to stone.
I do not care about anything else.
There are others of my kind in the cave.
I rubbed against it.

lines.zh: 两只蠹虫的壳叠在一起，咔咔响。
lines.en: Our two shells stack together with a clatter.
This burrow is roomy enough.
I bite it; it is stone.
This one I can gnaw.
Too soft; I will not eat it.
Too heavy to shift.
I gnaw off a small piece.
I keep this to gnaw at.
This does not smell of stone.

lines.zh: 这块石头，我啃完就变光滑。
lines.en: I will gnaw this stone smooth.
I stop and lift my head.
I smell danger.
I curl my body.

lines.zh: 洞口的石头被动了，我记住了。
lines.en: Someone moved the stones at my tunnel mouth; noted.
I hissed to call the others.
I am waiting for the burrowers.
They are close by.
I brace my legs.
What do you mean to do here?
My mouthparts have opened.

lines.zh: 那块石砖在响，我的触须竖了。
lines.en: That stone brick hums; my antennae rise.
I open my jaws and start to bite.
I will answer this one.
Do not touch my shell.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就跟着挪一步。
lines.en: One step back from you, one step from me.
I go around along the wall.

lines.zh: 一节一节地追，我的腿不会累。
lines.en: I chase segment by segment; my legs don't tire.
I curl into a half circle.
My legs never stop rustling.
I am waiting for the burrowers.
Their steps are closer.
I have risen a little.
My shell has spread.
I hissed again.
You are standing on stone chips.
I closed half a foot.
All my antennae are out.
I am waiting for your feet to show.
My head is lower than my shell.
I bite your foot.
I coil and snap open.
That bite went in hard.
I bite once and pull back.
My mouthparts are sharp.
That bite closed on nothing.
You kicked me and I rolled.
I get up and bite again.
My legs clamp your ankle.
That bite was not heavy.
I gnaw at your boot.
I butt my head against your shin.
I bite your trouser leg and pull.
I coil up again.
A patch of earth by the wall loosens.
Stone chips appear on the floor.
The stone here tastes good.

lines.zh: 我顺着新挖的通道过来。
lines.en: I come along the new tunnel.
My shell shines under the lamp.
I begin gnawing the stone under me.
A small one crawls behind me.
I raised my antennae to test the air.
I have found the trough.
I pause at the cave mouth.
I flatten myself out.
I am still covered in earth.
I crawl slowly into the light.
I spit out a mouthful of stone dust.
I grew up in this cave.
I come down through the seams in the stone.
I come from the trough.
The fire whitens my shell.

lines.zh: 我从墙上掉下来，壳先着地。
lines.en: I fall from the wall and land on my shell.
Something cracked my shell.
Some force tangles my legs.

lines.zh: 这一片石头都被啃光了。
lines.en: The stone here has all been gnawed away.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整只都紧成一团。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I clamp into a ball.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我抓不住任何东西。
lines.en: There is no ground and nothing to grip.
